articles.summary: New Allegiant Training Program invests in flight attendant development through a first-of-its-kind collaboration with one of the world's leading hospitality schools. ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) is taking the next step in its customer experience journey through a new partnership with the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) William F. Harrah College of Hospitality, bringing a customized customer experience training program to flight attendants across its network. The program leverages UNLV's expertise in service culture and training to strengthen Allegiant's customer experience as the airline grows. "Continuous learning is essential in a dynamic industry like aviation," said Tyler Hollingsworth, Allegiant's Chief Operating Officer. "This program encourages our teams to embrace new ideas and apply fresh insights that can make a meaningful impact for in-flight team members." articles.summary: Long-term agreement builds on a decade of success and positions the Allways Rewards Visa ® card for continued growth and enhanced customer value. ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) and Bank of America today announced a long-term extension of their co-branded credit card partnership, building on their successful relationship and shared commitment to customers well into the next decade. The renewed agreement reinforces both companies' commitment to delivering meaningful rewards, exclusive travel benefits and exceptional value to Allegiant customers through the award winning Allways Rewards Visa ® card. Since launching in 2016, Allegiant's co-branded credit card program has become a cornerstone of the company's loyalty strategy, helping customers earn rewards on everyday purchases while unlocking benefits designed to enhance their travel experience.
